evidence: The XRD result for the 850 Å-thick film obtained in this study ( Fig. 9 ) shows peaks of the dominant crystalline planes, {200} ((020) at 34.6°, (200) at 35.6°) and {1 1 1} (( −1 1 1) at 28.4°, (1 1 1) at 31.7°), indicating that the film was composed of a monoclinic crystal phase similar to that obtained in a previous study.
